title: Why every developer needs to learn prompt engineering

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the next big breakthrough in software comes not from code, but from how we ask AI to act?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, tools like LangChain and AutoGPT let developers build apps by crafting precise prompts, not just writing code.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if everyone uses prompts without understanding bias, we risk amplifying harmful stereotypes in AI outputs.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are building guardrails, bias detectors, and alignment layers to make prompt engineering safer and more transparent.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where developers shape AI's behavior with ethical intent, creating fairer and more inclusive systems.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future belongs to those who master both the power and the responsibility of prompt engineering.

video_cue: A developer typing a prompt, with AI-generated code and ethical guidelines appearing on screen simultaneously.
